description: Hamilton City Hall camp is supported through 30 November by municipal primary notice; CIVICUS reports a 30 December tent removal but characterizes it as week-long. The temporal gap and possibly renewed action prevent a seamless continuation claim. January closure was not established.
required_followup: Search contemporary Hamilton local reporting around 23–31 December and early January; distinguish continuous camp, hiatus, and restart.

description: Open-web searches covered Montreal/Quebec and Alberta by date, but did not systematically sweep every Canadian province, city, sector or all four weekly windows.
required_followup: Run targeted local English/French searches for 1–7, 8–14, 15–21 and 22–31 December in Atlantic, Prairie, BC and northern locations.

description: Edmonton attendance is reported as hundreds but lacks a city-specific named estimate; retain qualitative threshold evidence and do not borrow Calgary’s numeric range.

description: CIVICUS notes additional Toronto/Vancouver car caravans and consulate gatherings in solidarity with farmers in India, but exact dates, actual crowd details and any separate Canadian-state demand remain unresolved; do not count foreign-target solidarity as domestic protest.
